verdict.rationale: Probes confirm Perplexity's docs serve an llms.txt index (HTTP 200) and markdown versions of doc pages that point agents back to that index. An OpenAPI spec is also published, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs directly. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs, and evidence of a full-content variant (e.g. llms-full.txt).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://docs.perplexity.ai/llms.txt
PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://docs.perplexity.ai/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
